metadata.article_title: Procedure to be regulated by the Commission.

article.title: Procedure to be regulated by the Commission.
article.content:
(1) The Commission shall meet at such time and place as the Chairperson may think fit.
6[(2) Subject to the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder, the Commission shall have the power to lay down by regulations its own procedure.]
(3) All orders and decisions of the Commission shall be authenticated by the Secretary-General or any other officer of the Commission duly authorised by the Chairperson in this behalf.
article.html:
10Procedure to be regulated by the Commission.

Section 10 · Chapter II · page 6 of the Act

(1) The Commission shall meet at such time and place as the Chairperson may think fit.

6[(2) Subject to the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder, the Commission shall have the power to lay down by regulations its own procedure.]

(3) All orders and decisions of the Commission shall be authenticated by the Secretary-General or any other officer of the Commission duly authorised by the Chairperson in this behalf.

6 Subs. by Act 43 of 2006, s. 8, for sub-section (2) (w.e.f. 23-11-2006).
